findings.current: many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de non actives} (identical elsewhere arm in both keys)
findings.problem: The many arm inserts de before an adjective-only ellipsis without its noun. This yields « dont 1000000 de non actives », an unidiomatic nominalization instead of counting conversations. The French million de construction needs the counted noun here; completeness of CLDR labels alone does not make this arm grammatical. Both tooltip and accessible-name suffix contain the same defect. This is a grammatical/idiomatic defect at the required many category, not a wrong subset or unsafe action.
findings.suggested: In both keys replace the many arm with many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de conversations non actives}. For a fully explicit accessible-name continuation (the label itself contains no feminine plural noun), use one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} conversation non active} and other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} conversations non actives} in name_suffix_elsewhere as well. Preserve its initial comma and space.
